simple.meaning: מְחֹלָתִי (Mᵉchôlâthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Mecholathite or inhabitant of Abel-Mecholah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְחֹלָתִי (H4259) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 18:19, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְחֹלָתִי (H4259) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְחֹלָתִי (H4259) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְחֹלָתִי (Mᵉchôlâthîy) / H4259 is traced through 1 Samuel 18:19, 2 Samuel 21:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Mecholathite or inhabitant of Abel-Mecholah
definitions.full: H4259. Mecholathi מְחֹלָתִי adjective, of a people only with article ׳הַמְּ the Meholathite , of `Adriel 1Sam 18:19 , A τῷ Μοουλαθειτῃ ; ᵐ5 L τοῦ Μαολλαιου ; of Barzillai 2Sam 21:8 ; ᵐ5 τῷ Μωουλαθει , ᵐ5 L τοῦ Μααθει .

occurrences.englishText: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
